project: B2B Sport - Content Overhaul & Multi-Workflow System
description: Replace placeholder content with concept-aligned messaging across all pages (DA/EN/DE), refactor Workflow component to support multiple real-life workflows with carousel/tabs, and create new audience pages (For Brands, For Clubs). Tone: real company, real people — Danish club-focused warmth with hybrid B2B platform positioning.

userStories.title: Refactor Workflow component to support multiple workflows with tabs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Workflow component to accept and display multiple workflow configurations with tab navigation, so we can showcase different workflows on different pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow component accepts a `workflows` array prop, each entry with: id, title, steps[] (each step has label and iconKey string)
When multiple workflows are provided, render tab buttons above the flow canvas to switch between them
When a single workflow is provided, render without tabs (page-specific mode)
Tab styling uses existing design tokens: active tab bg-forest-900 text-cream-100, inactive text-forest-600
Desktop React Flow canvas updates nodes/edges when switching tabs
Mobile vertical step list updates when switching tabs
Icon mapping: iconKey strings (e.g. 'UserPlus', 'ShoppingCart') map to lucide-react components via a lookup object in the component
Backward compatible: if old-format single workflow props are passed, still renders correctly
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Navigate to http://localhost:3000 and confirm Workflow section still renders (will show single workflow until US-004 integrates multi-workflow data)

userStories.title: Add process-based workflow data to dictionaries
userStories.description: As a content author, I need process-based workflow content in all three language files so the homepage can display real platform workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Add workflow.workflows array to da.json, en.json, and de.json with 3 process-based workflows
Workflow 1 - Club Onboarding: steps are Register Club (UserPlus), Configure Profile (Settings), Set Up Staff (Users), Create Agreement (FileText), Activate Portal (Zap), Club Goes Live (CheckCircle)

Workflow 2 - Order Lifecycle: steps are Browse Catalog (Search), Add to Cart (ShoppingCart), Submit for Approval (Send), Admin Approves (CheckCircle), Order Confirmed (Package), Track Delivery (Truck)
Workflow 3 - Agreement Management: steps are Create Template (FileText), Set Terms & Pricing (Tag), Assign to Club (Building2), Club Accepts (ThumbsUp), Monitor Usage (BarChart3), Renew (RefreshCw)
Each workflow object has: id, title, subtitle, steps[] with label and iconKey
Keep existing workflow.title and workflow.subtitle as section-level headers but update to: DA 'Sådan fungerer platformen' / EN 'How the platform works' / DE 'So funktioniert die Plattform'

Update section subtitle to: DA 'Fra klub-oprettelse til levering — alt sker ét sted' / EN 'From club onboarding to delivery — everything happens in one place' / DE 'Von der Club-Einrichtung bis zur Lieferung — alles an einem Ort'
All three languages have complete translations for all workflow titles, subtitles, and step labels
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add audience-based workflow data to dictionaries
userStories.description: As a content author, I need audience-based workflow content in all three language files for use on audience-specific pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Add audienceWorkflows key to da.json, en.json, and de.json with 3 audience-based workflows

Workflow 1 - Brand Admin: steps are Onboard Club (UserPlus), Create Agreement (FileText), Configure Products (Package), Monitor Orders (BarChart3), Renew Partnerships (RefreshCw), Scale Network (TrendingUp)

Workflow 2 - Club Admin: steps are Accept Agreement (CheckCircle), Set Up Staff Access (Users), Define Budgets (Wallet), Approve Orders (ClipboardCheck), Track Spending (PieChart), Manage Renewals (RefreshCw)
Workflow 3 - Coach / Staff: steps are Log In (LogIn), View Products (Search), Check Team Sizes (Ruler), Place Order (ShoppingCart), Track Status (Clock), Receive Delivery (Truck)
Each workflow has: id, title, subtitle, steps[] with label and iconKey
All three languages have complete translations
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate multi-workflow tabs into homepage
userStories.description: As a visitor on the homepage, I want to see multiple platform workflows in a tabbed view so I understand the different processes the platform handles.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage passes all 3 process-based workflows from dictionary to the Workflow component
